# QueryHintParser

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Planning.QueryHintParser`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Parses query hints from ScriptDom AST and SQL comments. Standard OPTION() hints (MAXDOP) are extracted from the AST. Custom hints use SQL comment syntax: -- ppds:HINT_NAME [value]. Unrecognized hints are silently ignored.
